label_rule.quantity: probability the statistical model assigned to what happened (engine #1 played or not)

statistical.name: Regan-inspired statistical model
statistical.method: logistic-regression difficulty model + Elo band x difficulty decile projection table (training split), kappa-scaled z-scores (validation split). Not KNN.

prompt.eval_rule: clip(cp, -1000, 1000) / 100, formatted %+.2f; moves outside MultiPV -> n/a

runtime.hardware: laptop CPU with CPU-RAM + disk offload (accelerate device_map='auto'; modules per device {'cpu': 16, 'disk': 24}; no layers on the 4 GB RTX 3050 Ti)
runtime.scoring: sum of log-probabilities of every token of ' <uci>\n'; softmax over legal moves; nothing generated
runtime.scope: 7 MoveLens demo positions; not the held-out evaluation

examples.title: Models mostly agree
examples.rule: Statistical reading 'expected', Maia-3 rank of the played move <= 3 and, if Qwen was scored, Qwen rank <= 3; the featured position if it qualifies, otherwise the qualifying pool position with the highest Maia probability.
